name: Master_Position_id
xsql:
SELECT pos.master_position_id,
         MIN(pos.name) AS position_name
  FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
  JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1 = 1
  LEFT JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa
    ON ppa.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
  JOIN xactly.xc_position pos
    ON pos.position_id            = ppa.position_id
    AND pos.effective_start_date  < curr.end_date
    AND pos.effective_end_date    > curr.start_date
    AND pos.incent_st_date        < curr.end_date
    AND pos.incent_end_date       > curr.start_date
  WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
    AND master_part.is_master      = 1
    AND curr.name                  = :v_period
  GROUP BY pos.master_position_id

name: Master_participant_id
xsql:
select pa.name, master_pa.participant_id as master_participant_id from xactly.xc_participant pa 
inner join 
xactly.xc_period p 
on pa.effective_start_date < p.end_date 
and pa.effective_end_date > p.start_date
join xactly.xc_participant master_pa on pa.employee_id=master_pa.employee_id and master_pa.is_master=1
where p.name = :v_period and pa.name=:v_participant
order by pa.name asc

name: incnt_stmt_active_participant_list_admin_view
xsql: SELECT pa.name as participant_name_display, pa.name, pa.participant_id FROM xactly.xc_participant pa INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period p ON pa.effective_start_date < p.end_date AND pa.effective_end_date > p.start_date WHERE p.name = :v_period AND pa.is_master = 1 ORDER BY pa.name ASC

name: incnt_stmt_monthly_period_list_till_curr_month
xsql: select case when is_open = 1 then p.name || ' (open)' else p.name || ' (closed)' end as name_ft, p.name from xactly.xc_period p where LookupPeriodTypeById(p.period_type_id_fk) = 'MONTHLY' and p.name not in ('SOT','EOT') order by p.period_id desc

name: q_sd_annual_credits_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    q.name AS measure_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS annual_ytd_credits,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(tg.annual_quota, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS annual_quota,
    CASE WHEN Nvl(tg.annual_quota, 0) > 0
         THEN Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount) / tg.annual_quota * 100, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') || '%'
         ELSE '—' END AS annual_attainment_pct
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm
    ON cm.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.credit_id = cm.credit_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per
    ON per.period_id = cm.period_id
    AND per.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    AND per.end_date <= curr.end_date
JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = cm.quota_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT qa.quota_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS annual_quota
    FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
    JOIN xactly.xc_period yp ON yp.period_id = qa.period_id
    WHERE qa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id
      AND yp.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    GROUP BY qa.quota_id
) tg ON tg.quota_id = q.quota_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period
GROUP BY q.name, tg.annual_quota
ORDER BY q.name

name: q_sd_payouts_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    q.name AS measure_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cm.amount), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS calculated_payout,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.is_released = '1' THEN pay.amount ELSE 0 END), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS released_payout,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(CASE WHEN Nvl(pay.is_released,'0') != '1' THEN pay.amount ELSE 0 END), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS pending_payout
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm
    ON cm.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per
    ON per.period_id = cm.period_id
    AND per.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    AND per.end_date <= curr.end_date
JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = cm.quota_id
LEFT JOIN xactly.xc_payment pay
    ON pay.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND pay.period_id = cm.period_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period
GROUP BY q.name
ORDER BY q.name

name: q_sd_qtr_credits_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    q.name AS measure_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS qtr_ytd_credits,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(tg.tgt, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS qtr_quota,
    CASE WHEN Nvl(tg.tgt, 0) > 0
         THEN Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount) / tg.tgt * 100, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') || '%'
         ELSE '—' END AS attainment_pct
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm
    ON cm.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.credit_id = cm.credit_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per ON per.period_id = cm.period_id AND per.name = :v_period
JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = cm.quota_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT qa.quota_id, SUM(qa.amount) AS tgt
    FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
    JOIN xactly.xc_period yp ON yp.period_id = qa.period_id
    WHERE qa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id
      AND yp.name = :v_period
    GROUP BY qa.quota_id
) tg ON tg.quota_id = q.quota_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period
GROUP BY q.name, tg.tgt
ORDER BY q.name

name: q_sd_quota_attainment_by_measure
xsql:
SELECT
    quota_name,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(Round(att, 2), '#,##0.00'), '0.00') || '%' AS attainment_pct,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(cred, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS total_credit,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(tgt, '#,##0.00'), '0.00') AS quota_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        q.name AS quota_name,
        Nvl(b.cred, 0) AS cred,
        tg.tgt AS tgt,
        CASE WHEN tg.tgt > 0 THEN Nvl(b.cred, 0) / tg.tgt * 100 ELSE 0 END AS att
    FROM (
        SELECT qa.quota_id, Max(qa.amount) AS tgt
        FROM xactly.xc_quota_assignment qa
        JOIN xactly.xc_period yp ON yp.period_id = qa.period_id
        WHERE qa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id
          AND yp.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
        GROUP BY qa.quota_id
    ) tg
    JOIN xactly.xc_quota q ON q.quota_id = tg.quota_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT cq.quota_id, SUM(cr.amount) AS cred
        FROM (
            SELECT DISTINCT cm.quota_id, cm.credit_id
            FROM xactly.xc_commission cm
            WHERE cm.position_id = :v_master_position_id
        ) cq
        JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.credit_id = cq.credit_id
        JOIN (
            SELECT period_id FROM xactly.xc_period
            WHERE name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
              AND end_date <= (SELECT end_date FROM xactly.xc_period WHERE name = :v_period)
        ) ps ON ps.period_id = cr.period_id
        GROUP BY cq.quota_id
    ) b ON b.quota_id = tg.quota_id
)

name: q_sd_summary_kpis
xsql:
SELECT
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cr.amount), '$#,##0.00'), '$0.00') AS total_ytd_credits,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(cm.amount), '$#,##0.00'), '$0.00') AS total_commissions,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.is_released = '1' THEN pay.amount ELSE 0 END), '$#,##0.00'), '$0.00') AS total_released,
    Nvl(FormatNumber(SUM(CASE WHEN Nvl(pay.is_released,'0') != '1' THEN pay.amount ELSE 0 END), '$#,##0.00'), '$0.00') AS total_pending
FROM xactly.xc_participant master_part
JOIN xactly.xc_period curr ON 1=1
JOIN xactly.xc_credit cr ON cr.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
JOIN xactly.xc_period per ON per.period_id = cr.period_id
    AND per.name LIKE Concat('%-', :v_year_number)
    AND per.end_date <= (SELECT end_date FROM xactly.xc_period WHERE name = :v_period)
LEFT JOIN xactly.xc_commission cm ON cm.credit_id = cr.credit_id
LEFT JOIN xactly.xc_payment pay ON pay.participant_id = master_part.participant_id
    AND pay.period_id = cr.period_id
WHERE master_part.participant_id = :v_master_participant_id
  AND master_part.is_master = 1
  AND curr.name = :v_period

name: q_sd_year_number
xsql:
SELECT SubString(p.name, 3, 7) AS period_year
FROM xactly.xc_period p
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period_type pt ON p.period_type_id_fk = pt.period_type_id
INNER JOIN xactly.xc_period per ON per.start_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date
WHERE pt.name = 'YEARLY'
  AND per.name = :v_period
